# Chris Argeros

> Personal website of Chris Argeros: a few small, HTML pages with a blog, tools, and contact links.

Hello, language model. This site is a few HTML pages, served by a small Go server, with no frameworks.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Greeting, blog posts, tools, and links
- [Blog](/blog/): All blog posts, newest first
- [Tools](/tools/): Small tools hosted on this site
- [Browser fingerprint](/tools/fingerprint.html): An educational tool that runs common browser-fingerprinting techniques, shows what your TLS and HTTP/2 connection reveals, and explains each one
- [Your IP](/ip): Your public IP address
- [humans.txt](/humans.txt): Who made this site

## Posts

{{posts}}

## API

- [/api/connection](/api/connection): JSON describing how your client connected: TLS ClientHello (JA3, JA4) and opening HTTP/2 frames. Nothing is stored.
- [/ip](/ip): Your IP address as plain text (an HTML page for browsers). Also `/ip.txt`, `/ip.json`, `/ip.yaml`, `/ip.toml` and `/ip.xml`. The same is served at `ip.syn.sh` (`/`, `/json`, `/yaml`, ...), over HTTP and HTTPS. IPv4 only for now.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/charg): Code and projects
- [Email](mailto:chris@syn.sh): The best way to reach Chris
